description.fun: Rattata's fangs never stop growing, so it has to gnaw on hard things to keep them short, and a Trainer who forgets to give it something to chew may lose a door frame or two. It breeds so fast that a pair can quickly take over an area: see one and there are likely more than 40 around. Its biggest fan is Youngster Joey, who insists his Rattata is the best there is.
description.guide: A small purple rodent Pokémon whose large front teeth never stop growing, so it gnaws constantly to wear them down. It is cautious, hardy and breeds quickly, which makes it common almost everywhere. Its Alolan form is a nocturnal Dark and Normal type.
description.tagline: Always chewing, always multiplying, always one more nearby

description.fun: Rattata reached Alola on cargo ships, and when Yungoos were brought in to hunt them, they moved into towns and went nocturnal. Now dark-furred and part Dark-type, they sneak into homes for fresh food to bring their boss, an Alolan Raticate.

Raticate's teeth can gnaw through steel and keep growing, so it chews rocks, logs and sometimes the walls of houses to keep them trimmed. It uses its whiskers to balance and hates having them touched, biting anyone who tries, however friendly. It's also the only Pokémon whose Pokédex number, 20, matches the level it evolves at.
description.guide: The evolution of Rattata, a large, tawny rodent Pokémon with ever-growing incisors and webbed hind feet for swimming. It gnaws constantly to keep its teeth in check and uses its whiskers for balance. Its Alolan form is a plump Dark and Normal type that leads gangs of Alolan Rattata.
description.tagline: Steel-chewing teeth, and whiskers you mustn't touch

description.fun: City life and a rich diet made it heavier and darker. A gourmet with a taste for fresh, high-class food, it stays in its nest while the Alolan Rattata it commands go foraging, and restaurants use its taste buds to pick ingredients.
